Feature: Battery Alarms and Monitoring

  Scenario: GUI computes battery ETA from a history of remaining battery amounts
    Given the GUI has a history of remaining battery amounts
    When the GUI calculates the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA is computed accurately based on the history

  Scenario: GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the GUI connects to the battery amount sensor
    Then the GUI successfully retrieves battery amount data from the sensor

  Scenario Outline: GUI computes a "low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <30min
    Given the battery ETA is <time> minutes
    When the GUI checks the battery ETA
    Then the "low battery" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | time |
      | 29   |
      | 15   |
      | 0    |

  Scenario Outline: The "low battery" alarm is low priority
    Given the "low battery" alarm is triggered
    When the GUI checks the alarm priority
    Then the alarm priority is set to low
    Examples:
      | time |
      | 29   |
      | 15   |
      | 0    |

  Scenario Outline: GUI computes a "critically low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <10min
    Given the battery ETA is <time> minutes
    When the GUI checks the battery ETA
    Then the "critically low battery" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | time |
      | 9    |
      | 5    |
      | 0    |

  Scenario Outline: The "critically low battery" alarm is high priority
    Given the "critically low battery" alarm is triggered
    When the GUI checks the alarm priority
    Then the alarm priority is set to high
    Examples:
      | time |
      | 9    |
      | 5    |
      | 0    |

  Scenario: GUI reads hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the GUI reads the hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Then the GUI successfully retrieves battery presence and chargeability status

  Scenario: GUI has a "battery failure" alarm when the battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    Given the battery is <status>
    When the GUI checks the battery status
    Then the "battery failure" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | status       |
      | absent       |
      | unavailable  |
      | unchargeable |
